artifacts.summary: 3-phase implementation: red-then-green --fix fixture extension, has()->type-test mutation-filter swap plus comment rewrite in validate-state.sh, full verification of the three file_scope dedup invariants (D3 order, no-manufacture, idempotence).

completion_data.completion_summary: Fixed validate-state.sh --fix crashing on literal-null file_scope by swapping the mutation filter's has("file_scope") presence test for the type test (.file_scope|type)=="array", rewrote the comment block that had endorsed the defective form, and extended the FIX_FIXTURE_DIR regression fixture with red-then-green proof (24/1 failed before, 25/0 failed after) plus direct-repro and double-run idempotence verification.

memory_candidates.content: When a fix targets a jq filter that silently no-ops instead of crashing loudly on some code paths (this repo's validate-state.sh --fix: rc could be 0 even when the write was refused, because the failure branch used a raw echo instead of log_fail), a regression fixture's rc check alone proves nothing. The load-bearing proof is: (1) confirm the fixture is RED against the UNFIXED code first (here: 24 passed/1 failed, with diagnostics showing the write did NOT land and the specific failure string present in $out) before applying the fix, then (2) after the fix, assert the fixture went GREEN (25/0) AND that a genuine change elsewhere in the same fixture actually landed (e.g. a real duplicate was actually removed), not just that the run didn't crash. A fixture that only asserts 'no crash' or 'rc==0' can pass vacuously when the underlying write silently failed.
